summary: The Gap, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 2 to its existing asset-based revolving credit facility (ABL Credit Facility) on July 17, 2026. The amendment extends the maturity date to July 2031, removes sustainability-linked pricing adjustments, and makes regulatory updates. The $2.2 billion facility size, sublimits ($300M letters of credit, $200M swingline, $200M Canadian borrowings), and interest rate structure remain largely unchanged. This is a routine refinancing/credit agreement amendment and does not represent a special situation event like a merger, tender, or activist campaign.
